title: Nothing signals in advance that choosing a route between Acts (the pilgrim stair into Marrowgate vs. the writ, etc.) permanently forecloses that region's remaining side content - only found out when a companion (Osk) remarked mid-Coldpass that his own personal grief quest (Fenmarch) was now unreachable.
